pre_fix_failure_path: fresh worker installs a temporary quote-context verifier and issued_contexts id registry
fresh worker builds direct fresh context and calls Price-all
canonical adapter temporarily relays verifier into legacy Price-all module
Price-all module's imported verifier can see the temporary verifier while that call is active
the adapter restores the imported module verifier before Router replay
Router calls its import-by-value verify_shadow_price_all_bundle function
that replay resolves the restored legacy direct-only context verifier
PRF_CURRENT_RECONCILIATION_FRESH_REPRICE is rejected as unknown current Shadow source-context mode
active_worker_install_order: request worker applies reconciliation identity proxy, then XG fallback, then delegates to daily
daily worker binds fixture search horizon and explicit-date issuer
daily installs identity recovery, quote-row parser, history artifact verification reuse, history builder-audit reuse, history semantic replay reuse
bound worker installs adapter verifier relay; timeout budget mutation is separate and only used while writing timeout receipt
fresh worker installs quote verifier plus issued_contexts ID registry, Portfolio builder override, and runner acquisition override
summary reuse worker replaces all-market history/XG installer functions and wraps history SHA calculation
all-market worker installs history caches/reuse, Price context verifier cache, Portfolio reconciliation facade, and diagnostics wrappers
runner then composes direct context -> Price-all -> Router -> Portfolio; fresh acquisition wrapper later composes fresh context -> Price-all -> Router -> Portfolio
